question: What sage and seed syllable are associated with this mantra’s six-limb ritual?
premises: Prajapati is declared the sage of the mantra
The seed syllable śrīṃ is used
The six-limb ritual is performed with it
inference: Prajapati is the sage and the six-limb ritual is performed with the seed syllable śrīṃ.
plain_english: Prajapati is declared the sage, and the six-limb ritual is performed with the seed syllable śrīṃ.
